evidence.quote: We propose a $40 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members using Brightline’s records, plus $3.5 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
any fees the court declines to award would augment the class fund rather than revert to Brightline.

summary: Plaintiff’s opening proposal included both class relief and fees, before the class fund was agreed. The proposal expressly directed any unawarded fees to the class fund, linking the fee award to class recovery. The transcript does not show counsel trading class relief for its own compensation, defense exploiting a fee interest, or a misleading declaration.
